name: Ryoujoku Fukushuu Gakuen ~Rinkan no Houkago~
original_name: 凌辱復讐学園～輪姦の放課後～
source:
Junichi has a girlfriend, Ayaka. One day, when they are on their way home, he is hit by someone, and becomes unconscious.... When he regains his consciousness, he finds Ayaka being raped by several men.... A few days later, Ayaka regains her consciousness in the hospital. But, she has lost all of her memories.... Junichi gets mad, and decides to take revenge...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090303062938/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1007674]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
纯一有一个女朋友，绫香。有一天，在回家的路上，他被人撞倒，昏迷不醒……当他恢复意识时，发现绫香被几个男人强奸……几天后，绫香在医院苏醒。但是，她失去了所有的记忆……纯一生气了，决定报仇……
